questions.question: How long does it take to blink your eyes once?
questions.explain: A blink happens faster than you can say the word 'blink,' so one second is just right. Picking hours or days makes the blink way too long.

questions.question: How long is a school day?
questions.explain: A school day is a few hours long, so 6 hours fits. Six minutes is too short, and six days or six weeks is way too long.

questions.question: How long do you sleep at night?
questions.explain: Sleeping is a long rest, so about 10 hours makes sense. Ten minutes or ten seconds is way too short, and ten weeks is far too long.

questions.question: How long does it take to cross the street at a corner?
questions.explain: Crossing a street is quick, so 30 seconds is the right size. Thirty minutes, days, or years would be way too long for just walking across.

questions.question: Dad works from the morning until 5 in the afternoon. He says his workday is about 8 hours. Is that sensible?
questions.explain: A workday is a few hours, so 8 hours makes sense. Minutes would be too short, and days or weeks would be way too long for one day at work.

questions.question: You wait 5 minutes in line at the snack shop. Then you eat your snack for 10 minutes. Which makes the most sense for your whole time?
questions.explain: Five minutes plus ten minutes is fifteen minutes, which is a sensible total. Fifteen hours or fifteen days is way too long, and fifteen seconds is too short to eat a snack.

questions.question: A teacher says, 'The school year is about 9 months.' A student says, 'No, it is about 9 weeks.' Who has the sensible answer?
options: The student, a week is longer than a month
Both, 9 months and 9 weeks are the same
The teacher, a month is longer than a week
Neither, a school year is only 9 days
questions.explain: A month is longer than a week, so 9 months is a sensible school year. Nine weeks would be much shorter than a real school year.

questions.question: You read a book for 15 minutes every night for 4 nights. About how long is the reading in total?
questions.explain: Fifteen minutes times 4 is 60 minutes, which is about 1 hour. A day, week, or month is way too long for four short reading sessions.

questions.question: Grandma bakes muffins for the class party. She sets the kitchen timer before she puts the tray in the oven. Which time makes sense for baking the muffins?
questions.explain: Muffins bake while you wait a short while, so minutes fit. Twenty seconds is far too short, and twenty hours is almost a whole day.

questions.question: Sam's winter break starts in December. He stays home from school until January. Which length makes sense for his break?
questions.explain: December to January is many days in a row, and that is about two weeks. Two hours is less than one morning, and two years is longer than two whole grades.

questions.question: Leo heats a bowl of soup in the microwave after school. He wants it warm but not too hot. Which time makes sense?
questions.explain: A microwave warms soup in a few minutes. Three seconds is not long enough to heat it at all.

questions.question: Room 12 plants bean seeds by the window. The teacher says the first green leaves will come soon. Which wait makes sense?
questions.explain: A seed needs more than one day to sprout, so days make sense. Hours are far too short, and six years is longer than you have been in school.

questions.question: Jen has a swim lesson on Tuesday and another one on Thursday. Each lesson is 30 minutes long. Which is a sensible total for both lessons?
questions.explain: Two lessons of 30 minutes make 60 minutes, and 60 minutes is the same as 1 hour. Sixty minutes is nowhere near a whole day.

questions.question: A movie starts at 4 o'clock and ends at 6 o'clock. Ben says the movie was 2 ___ long. Which unit fits the blank?
questions.explain: From 4 o'clock to 6 o'clock is a jump of 2 hours on the clock. Two minutes would be over before the show even started.

questions.question: Four kids write about time in their journals. Which sentence makes sense?
options: One week is shorter than one day.
questions.explain: Recess is a short break outside, and about 20 minutes fits it well. A sneeze is over in a second, and a week is much longer than a day.

questions.question: Ty says his bus ride to school takes 20 seconds. What is wrong with what he said?
options: 20 seconds is too long a time.
A bus ride should be in days.
questions.explain: You can only count to about 20 in 20 seconds, so a bus ride needs minutes instead. Remember that a minute is longer than a second.
